description: Use this when a freelancer or business owner asks how much estimated tax to pay or whether they are underpaid for the year. Computes federal self-employment and income tax on annualized income, the safe-harbor target, per-quarter amounts and due dates, plus California's 30/40/0/30 installment timing.

entity.description: How the income is taxed. Sole proprietor / SMLLC / partnership pay self-employment tax; S-corp shareholders take wages (withheld) plus distributions.

prior_year_agi_usd.description: Last year's adjusted gross income (AGI). If over $150,000 ($75,000 MFS), the prior-year safe harbor rises from 100% to 110%.

prior_year_total_tax_usd.description: Total federal tax on last year's return. Enables the prior-year safe harbor (often the easiest to hit).

state.description: US state. Only California installment timing is modeled specifically; when omitted, no state is assumed and only federal figures are computed.

ytd_net_income_usd.description: Your net self-employment / business income so far THIS year (year to date), before tax.

ytd_withholding_usd.description: Federal tax already withheld this year (e.g. from a W-2 or S-corp salary). Counts toward the safe harbor.

name: estimate_quarterly_taxes

next_step.description: A single review link appropriate to this server surface.

relay.description: Instruction to the calling assistant: relay figures and dates verbatim (identical on every response).

server_version.description: Server release that produced this response (matches GET /version).
